text: Which system integration specialists in Newcastle are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?

result.keyword: Which system integration specialists in Newcastle are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?

items.markdown:
Connecting heavy-hitting platforms like ERPs, CRMs, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 requires a specialized partner. Because enterprise-grade systems (especially SAP and MYOB Acumatica) have distinct architectural frameworks, local businesses in Newcastle typically rely on a mix of **regional enterprise IT consultancies**, **major national implementation partners with regional NSW reach** , and **specialized boutique system integrators**.

Finding the right fit depends on which core platform anchors your ecosystem.

### 1. MYOB Acumatica Specialists (Enterprise Cloud ERP)

If your primary operational or financial backbone is **MYOB Acumatica** (formerly MYOB Advanced), you need accredited enterprise partners who understand both the ERP framework and how to bridge it via APIs to Microsoft 365 or custom CRMs:[[1]](https://www.myob.com/au/implementation-partners?srsltid=AYCX9vIwoKpnlow7d0MAtIlk4wmQ01KggAv6rbEghFLeIgQoxixjX0z7)

- **Kilimanjaro Consulting:** As one of the largest enterprise implementation partners for MYOB Acumatica in Australia, they service New South Wales and regional hubs. They specialize in deep integrations, custom reporting, add-on modules, and process optimization. You can review their service profile via [Kilimanjaro Consulting](https://kilimanjaro-consulting.com/).[[1]](https://kilimanjaro-consulting.com/)
- **Momentum Software Solutions & Stratus Group:** These are prominent NSW-accredited enterprise partners for MYOB Acumatica that handle complex migrations and API integrations connecting inventory, payroll, and CRM data across regional operations.[[1]](https://www.myob.com/au/implementation-partners)

### 2. SAP Implementation & Integration Partners

For **SAP** environments (such as SAP S/4HANA or SAP Business ByDesign/Business One), local on-the-ground presence in Newcastle is usually backed by major national or multinational consultancies that deploy hybrid or remote teams into the Hunter Region:

- **Tier-1 / Tier-2 Consultancies (e.g., Deloitte, Accenture, PwC, or specialized local SAP partners):** For heavy industry, manufacturing, and supply chain logistics common to Newcastle/Hunter, enterprise SAP integrations are typically managed through dedicated enterprise architecture firms listed on the [SAP Partner Finder](https://www.sap.com/australia/partners/find.html) . They provide middleware integration (like SAP Integration Suite) to sync SAP data seamlessly with Microsoft 365 and external CRMs.[[1]](https://www.sap.com/australia/partners/find.html)

### 3. Microsoft 365, CRM, & Custom API Integrations

If your challenge is making SAP, MYOB, and other datasets flow cleanly into **Microsoft 365** (Teams, SharePoint, Azure) or a custom **CRM** environment:

- **Local Boutique System Developers (e.g., LOC'X or similar Hunter-based digital/software agencies):** For mid-market businesses looking to build bespoke middle-layer workflow automation, custom dashboards (Business Intelligence), and direct API handshakes between Microsoft tools and accounting databases, localized developers design around specific operational workflows rather than generic templates.[[1]](https://locx.com.au/newcastle/system-development)
- **Strategic Group:** A long-standing Newcastle-based IT provider with decades of regional experience, specializing in managed cloud environments, infrastructure management, and bridging accounting/ERP data pipelines securely for mid-to-large operations.[[1]](https://strategicgroup.net.au/accounting/)

To help narrow down the ideal specialist for your project, please share:

- What is your **primary core system** (e.g., is the business anchored on SAP, MYOB Acumatica, or Microsoft Dynamics)?
- What specific **endpoints** do you need to connect first?
- Roughly how **many users** or data volume are involved?
